duartesantos8/opengym.creator: marc.kaz
duartesantos8/opengym.caption:
openGym is a self-hosted workout and body-weight logger. One Docker Compose command. Your server. Your data.

Ships with:
• 5,600+ exercises with animated demos
• Guided sessions, rest timers, and PR detection
• Muscle map, 1RM, and body-weight charts
• Import from FitNotes, Strong, and Hevy
• Passk
